skills.name: zentropi-labeler
skills.description: Build, test, optimize, and run content classifiers ("labelers") with Zentropi's CoPE model through the unified `zentropi-labeler` CLI. Use to create labelers from plain-English policies, manage test datasets, benchmark accuracy (precision/recall/F1), run AI-assisted optimization, use community labelers, and classify text or images — one item or at production volume.
headings: The mental model: one tool, two intents
Run from this skill's own directory (where SKILL.md lives):
1. Create a labeler. This saves a *draft* (nothing is deployed yet).
2. Spot-check the draft on ad-hoc content, without saving anything.
3. Happy with it? Deploy the draft to make it live.
4. Run production inference against the deployed version.
